answer: A garden economy resists sybils by fingerprinting behavior the way a quill leaves a distinct stroke: each agent earns its terrace of attestations only by completing long, varied, independently verified work over weeks — timing, task diversity, peer endorsements — forming a signature no farm can mass-produce. One extra fake identity costs roughly 200 hours of genuine attested work plus a forfeitable stake that doubles per identity sharing a funding source, so the tenth fake costs over a thousand hours and a 512-unit bond.
